elements.title: Todas as vendas
elements.commandsql:
SELECT u.id AS u_id, 
          u.firstname, 
          u.lastname, 
          u.email,
          c.id AS c_id, 
          c.fullname, 
          pm.method, 
          pm.value, 
          CASE 
            WHEN pm.status = 'waiting' THEN 'Aguardando pagamento'
            WHEN pm.status = 'paid' THEN 'Pago'
          END AS status_transaction,
          pm.lasttime
     FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment pm
     JOIN mdl_user                  u ON pm.userid = u.id
     JOIN mdl_course                c ON pm.course = c.id
    WHERE u.id      > 1
      AND u.deleted = 0
 Group BY u.id
 ORDER BY u.firstname ASC, u.lastname ASC

elements.title: Cursos Populares por Pagamento
elements.commandsql:
SELECT 
    c.fullname,
    COUNT(mp.id) AS num_students,
    SUM(mp.value) AS total_amount_paid
FROM mdl_course c
JOIN mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment mp ON mp.course = c.id
WHERE mp.status='paid'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC
